evidence.detail: Exact v308 compares rs/d/d NPC definitions field-by-field, emits the surviving diagnostic 'Found differences in NPC ...', and builds only changed NPC properties into maps keyed by definition ID.
Its dump path serializes the accumulated changed NPC fields through rs/t/a into e.yaml, with paired compiled path e.bin, then prints '..Dump completed!'.
Its second public action loads the reviewed NpcDefinitionConfigLoader, recomputes per-ID differences and prints the non-ignored changed properties for inspection.

candidates.note: NpcDefinitionDiffDumper is a conservative semantic recovery name fixed by exact NPC-definition comparison and e.yaml/e.bin diff output behavior. Confidence 0.999.

evidence.detail: Exact v308 compares rs/d/k item definitions field-by-field, emits the surviving diagnostic 'Found differences in item ...', and builds only changed item properties into maps keyed by definition ID.
Its dump path serializes changed item fields through rs/t/a into i.yaml, with paired compiled path i.bin, then prints '..Dump completed!'.

Its second public action loads the reviewed ItemDefinitionConfigLoader, prints 'Running test..', recomputes per-ID differences and reports non-ignored changes while preserving old values for selected diagnostics.

candidates.note: ItemDefinitionDiffDumper is a conservative semantic recovery name fixed by exact item-definition comparison and i.yaml/i.bin diff output behavior. Confidence 0.999.
